integrity: Self-contained proof and a reproducible exact-integer checker supplied; independent external mathematical assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves a sharp inequality only for multiplicity m >= 4 and embedding dimension e=m-1; does not resolve all of Wilf’s conjecture. Finite checks do not prove the universal result. Residual risk: equivalent result in literature not found, particularly recent type/Apéry research whose full text was inaccessible.
title: A sharp Wilf-number gap at almost-maximal embedding dimension
